_scenario.title: Key Account Manager
_scenario.persona: Runs export and import accounts: a container stuck in customs, a pharma RFQ due at 5pm and an unpaid invoice dispute.

all_tasks.task_details: Customs hold update on container APXU 4471 at Chattogram
Online cold-chain solution session with Mehnaz and their QA head
Submit the RFQ response for cold-chain air freight to Dubai - hard deadline
Resolve the demurrage charge dispute on the October import
Send revised contract rates for the 2027 renewal
Quarterly business review with Apex Knitwear management
Intro call: trial shipment of 2 pallets of tea to London

all_followups.followup_details: Send the revised ETA and vessel details for PO 88213
Get the renewal decision before their finance meeting
Share the day-by-day demurrage breakdown with document timestamps
Send the UK rate card and export document checklist
File the amended commercial invoice (correct HS code) with customs through our CHA agent

all_notes.content: Container APXU 4471 held at Chattogram since 31 Oct: HS code on the invoice (6109) doesn't match the packing list (6110). Must make the 6 Nov vessel or the EU buyer's window (12 Nov) is missed - 8% late penalty. Apex's MD is following this personally.

Annual cold-chain volume around 40 tons - would be our largest pharma account. Competing with two global forwarders. Their QA head cares about temperature logger data and GDP certification more than price.
A competitor offered 6% lower per container. Tariq likes our reliability but finance is pushing on cost. Contract expires 30 Nov. Account worth about BDT 1.8 crore a year.
Disputes 4 days of demurrage (BDT 1.2 lakh) - says the delay was caused by our late documents. Customer for 7 years. Their accounts team is holding our October invoice.
Apex's EU buyer. Asked for proactive updates after last season's delays and escalates to Rezaul whenever she isn't updated.

all_calls.transcript: Rezaul: Arif, my MD is asking me every hour about the container. What's the status? Arif: Customs flagged the HS code - your invoice says 6109 but the packing list says 6110. Rezaul: Our merchandiser made that mistake. How do we fix it? Arif: I'll get the amended commercial invoice filed with customs by Tuesday noon, and our CHA agent will push for same-day assessment. Rezaul: If it misses the vessel on the 6th, we miss the buyer's window and pay eight percent penalty. Arif: Understood, it's my top priority. Rezaul: And please update Sarah at Nordic Wear directly. She's emailing me every day and I don't have answers for her. Arif: I'll email her the revised ETA and vessel details.

Mehnaz: The RFQ covers air freight to Dubai at two to eight degrees, roughly forty tons a year. Arif: What matters most to your team? Mehnaz: Our QA head will look at your GDP certificate and how you monitor temperature in transit. Price matters, but a failed excursion costs us far more. Arif: We use calibrated loggers with live tracking. I'll share a sample temperature log report from our last pharma shipment. Mehnaz: Good, include it in the RFQ. Submission closes Tuesday at 5pm and there are no extensions. Arif: Understood. Who else is bidding? Mehnaz: Two of the big global forwarders. Arif: Then we'll make the cold-chain evidence the centre of our response.

Hasan: Arif bhai, seven years we've worked together and now a 1.2 lakh demurrage bill? My team says your documents reached the port late. Arif: I hear you. Let me check the timeline properly. Hasan: Check it, but my accounts team won't release your October invoice until this is settled. Arif: I'll pull the document timestamps and send you a day-by-day breakdown by Tuesday. If the delay is on our side, we'll waive it. Hasan: That's fair. Just don't make me chase you.

Tariq: I'll be honest, another forwarder quoted six percent lower per container. Arif: We'd like to keep your business. What would make it work? Tariq: I prefer your service, you've never missed a slot for us. But finance only sees the number. Send me revised rates by the end of the month and I'll take them to finance. Arif: I'll send revised rates by the 31st, with a volume tier. Tariq: Good. The contract ends 30 November, so finance wants to decide early.

Nabila: Hi, we're a tea exporter from Sylhet. We want to try a trial shipment, two pallets to London in about two weeks. Arif: Happy to help. Sea or air? Nabila: Sea if the transit time is reasonable. Can you send me your rate card and the list of documents we need? Arif: I'll email both, and we can talk properly tomorrow at 11:30. Nabila: Perfect.

all_messages.subject: ETA for PO 88213?
all_messages.content: Arif, our stores launch the collection on 15 November. I need a confirmed ETA and vessel name today, otherwise we have to plan air freight - at your cost, per the contract.

all_messages.subject: Reminder: RFQ closes 5pm today
all_messages.content: A reminder that the cold-chain RFQ closes at 5pm today. Please include the GDP certificate and the sample temperature log.
Waiting for the breakdown. My accounts team won't release your October invoice until this is sorted.

all_messages.subject: Renewal
all_messages.content: Hi Tariq, working on the revised rates, you'll have them before month end.

all_messages.subject: Re: Renewal
all_messages.content: Arif, finance meets Thursday. If I don't have your rates by then I'll have to present the other quote only.
CHA says the amended invoice must be filed before 1pm for today's assessment. Please confirm.

all_messages.subject: Rate card + document checklist
all_messages.content: Thanks for the call. Please send the rate card and the document checklist when you can.
